testFiles.description: Only run test files matching these regular expressions

config.description: Configuration file, relative to the project root. Defaults to playwright.config.ts in the project root.

project.description: Only run tests from these projects of the config

grep.description: Only run tests matching this regular expression

grepInvert.description: Only run tests not matching this regular expression

ui.description: Run tests in interactive UI mode

workers.description: Number of concurrent workers or percentage of logical CPU cores, e.g. 50%

retries.description: Maximum retry count for flaky tests

maxFailures.description: Stop after the first N failures

reporter.description: Reporter to use, comma-separated, e.g. list,html

shard.description: Shard tests and execute only the selected shard, e.g. 1/3

passWithNoTests.description: Make test run succeed even if no tests were found

list.description: Collect all the tests and report them, but do not run

env.description: Environment variables to set for the test process
